objective: Ship the fluorophore/color-panel spillover advisor: qualitative peak-proximity flags over a Claude-drafted, Daniel-reviewable spectral KB, as its own step.

decisions.data_source: naming.fields.markers (existing free-text field), parsed via engine/validation.js's splitMarkers -- NOT panel.targets/panel.channels (reserved, zero consumers, left untouched)
decisions.content_owner: Claude drafts spectral values, flagged in-app and in docs as needing Daniel's review -- same arrangement as advisor.json's 16 rules
decisions.overlap_rule: qualitative peak-proximity only (emissionProximityNm=25 error, excitationProximityNm=20 warning), both stored as KB data not engine constants -- no spectral-overlap-integral math
decisions.content_scope: ~35-40 well-documented markers.json entries; ambiguous/heterogeneous ones (BODIPY, RFP, FURA2, ARL, SOX, SOX2, CELLMASK, ERTRACKER) explicitly excluded as honest gaps, resolve to spectrum-unavailable

invariants: engine/spectra.js is pure and total -- no DOM, no store, never throws on malformed/missing input
rules-as-data: overlapRules thresholds live in web/kb/spectra.json, not hardcoded in engine/spectra.js
five-state resolution per marker token; an empty/excluded/ambiguous case must always render a specific sentence, never a blank row or silent omission
web/ never imports from src/; zero npm deps; node --test and pytest -m 'not integration' both stay green
verify against the BUILT artifact (tools/build_single_file.py output), not just file:// or the dev server (lessons 47/48)
out_of_scope: Overview/studydoc.js integration (deferred, PAN-7 dropped from this run)
